title: LitTraceQA：答案對，不代表整條證據鏈都對

source.citation: Liu X, Wang Y, Shi P, et al. LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering. arXiv:2608.07370v1. 2026.

study_profile.study_type: benchmark-development paper with a public development split and a larger local annotation collection
study_profile.synthesis_mode: task and evaluation protocol definition plus author-reported corpus audit

not_applicable_reasons.total_participants: This is a scientific-QA benchmark paper, not a human-participant outcome study.
not_applicable_reasons.follow_up: The paper reports static benchmark-development artefacts rather than longitudinal outcomes.

artifact_receipts.role: Canonical arXiv v1 full text used to audit the task schema, corpus statistics, evaluation protocol and release limitations.
Canonical queue matched to rendered cards C01-C06 by exact title sequence.
Rejected as the card specification because its six titles describe a different card plan.
Digest of the title-bound C01-C06 image manifest recorded in card_storyboard.json.

observations.description: The article follows the benchmark's decision path: problem, three-part output contract, evidence types, construction, corpus profile, separated scoring, release limits and reusable design value.
evidence_locations: article:這篇論文想解決什麼問題

observations.description: Answer correctness is repeatedly separated from paper retrieval and evidence grounding; success is permitted only when all three stages pass.
The paper-evidence-answer trace acts as the explanatory spine, while oracle paper and oracle evidence are presented as bottleneck-isolation settings rather than scores.
Corpus numbers are translated into operational meaning and then capped: 61.9% is construction-time hardness metadata, not retrieval-augmented performance.
Scale claims are paired with split and release-status brakes; diversity claims are paired with venue, duplicate-set and sparse-evidence warnings.
evidence_locations: article:資料是怎麼建構出來的

observations.description: The public development split, larger local collection, paper-defined protocol, author-reported audit and future release requirements remain distinct authority layers.
evidence_locations: article:資料是怎麼建構出來的

observations.description: Construction details are part of the evidence assessment: open-book generation, automated grounding, closed-book challenge filtering, deduplication and residual corpus anomalies.
evidence_locations: article:資料是怎麼建構出來的

observations.description: Unfinished locator normalization, official splits, licensing, human review and retrieval-augmented baselines directly prohibit calling the local collection a completed public benchmark release.
The article permits reuse of the three-stage diagnostic framework while withholding claims that the benchmark release and governance process are complete.
evidence_locations: article:為什麼這個設計值得注意

observations.description: Paper-defined task semantics are separated from corpus statistics that remain author-reported and not independently replicated.
A construction-time closed-book failure share must not inherit the meaning of an end-to-end or RAG benchmark score.
Joint success is a logical conjunction across paper, evidence and answer components, not an average and not a mathematical union.

Four cards preserve source meaning and two fail semantically: C02 fabricates evidence-status grades for object classes and C05 fabricates venue-bar geometry that contradicts the source. C01 is source-aligned but contains unauthorised explanatory text. All six fail the exact visible-text render contract.

The register is diagnostic rather than promotional: compact technical terms are followed by concrete failure cases and immediate boundary language about what a statistic or release state does not mean.
A chart's category inclusion, ordering and geometry are quantitative claims; correct adjacent prose cannot rescue a chart that omits the dominant category or reverses ranks.

contamination_notes.location: 一句話總結、怎麼評分、為什麼這個設計值得注意
contamination_notes.issue: The article calls strict joint success a '嚴格聯集'. A logical AND is a conjunction/intersection condition, not a union.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Use '嚴格合取', '三段全部通過', or '邏輯 AND' consistently.

contamination_notes.issue: The phrase '三個正交的схема軸' contains an accidental Cyrillic word and obscures the intended schema terminology.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Replace with '三個正交軸' or '三個正交的 schema 軸'.

contamination_notes.location: 資料是怎麼建構出來的
contamination_notes.issue: The article hardens the challenger names to GPT, Claude and Gemma even though the paper uses Gemma in the main text/figure and Gemini in appendix verifier logs.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Say '三個 closed-book challenger 模型' or explicitly disclose the Gemma/Gemini naming inconsistency.
